---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any page of Unscroll, a focus timer and screen-time check-in website.
---

1. Brand name is "Unscroll", tagline "Put the phone down. Pick the day up." Show both in every page header.
2. Tone is calm, dry and kind. Short sentences, no exclamation marks, never guilt the user.
3. Colours: background #F1ECE2, text #1E1E1C, primary #4E5B31, accent #E2894F only for the Start button, selected answers and progress. During breaks the page turns #4E5B31 with #F1ECE2 text.
4. Fonts from Google Fonts: "Instrument Serif" headings, "IBM Plex Mono" timer and numbers, "IBM Plex Sans" body.
5. Style is flat and editorial: square corners, 1px #1E1E1C lines between sections.
6. Every page has a header linking "Focus" (index.html) and "Check-in" (quiz.html), and the footer "Unscroll, 2026".
7. index.html: huge mono timer left of centre; presets 25/5, 50/10, 15/3; Start, Pause, Reset; thin top progress bar; countdown in tab title; soft chime at the end with a sound toggle; sessions-today counter; numbered ruled to-do list. Save tasks and settings in localStorage.
8. quiz.html: 8 questions, two each on Mornings, Impulse, Focus and Nights, one at a time with segmented progress. Answers are lettered rows A to C; clicking sweeps an apricot highlight across, fades the others, then slides in the next question.
9. Results: score out of 100, label (Balanced, Slipping, Time to unplug), animated bar per area, strongest and weakest area, three tips, and a button to index.html with a suggested preset.
10. Write times as mm:ss (25:00) and scores as whole numbers (72/100).
11. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only, mobile friendly.
12. Never use rounded cards, drop shadows, gradients, emoji or generic template layouts.
